Dear
Eduard Semiraut

Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Ankita
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P0 170001042
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
w8xaf6
Problem Description
: Outlet 2 out of order
I wanted to inform you that charger outlets were temporarily unavailable due to a COAP error.
The COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the SiC D and the SECC. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue, and the SiC D will automatically reconnect to the SECC within approximately 5 seconds.
During this period when the SECC is unreachable, you may see an "Outlet out of order" flag. This is a normal indication that the system is not currently connected, but this status will be cleared as soon as the connection is reestablished. Additionally, you might notice a "preparing" status displayed in the HMI occasionally, which is also part of the normal recovery process.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387933
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
